units.source_text: 皇上虽然春秋已高，在女人面上却并不疏懒。

en.t: Although the emperor was already advanced in years, he was by no means indifferent when it came to women.

units.source_text: 宫女之中，采女和女藏人[\[12\]](#part1336.html#m12)，只要是姿色美好而聪明伶俐的，都蒙皇上另眼看待。

en.t: Among the women of the palace, any serving woman or female chamberlain[\[12\]](#part1336.html#m12) who was beautiful and clever received special favor from the emperor.

units.source_text: 因此当时宫中美女甚多。

en.t: For that reason, there were very many beautiful women in the palace at the time.

units.source_text: 如果源氏公子肯对这些女人略假辞色，恐怕没有一人不趋奉他。

en.t: If Prince Genji had shown even the slightest kindness to these women, there would probably not have been a single one who did not eagerly attend on him.

units.source_text: 但他大约是看惯了之故吧，对她们异常淡然。

en.t: But perhaps because he was so used to seeing them, he was exceptionally indifferent toward them.

units.source_text: 有时这些女人试把风情的话来挑拨他，他也只是勉强敷衍应对。

en.t: Sometimes these women tried to provoke him with flirtatious words, but he merely forced himself to give perfunctory replies.

units.source_text: 因此有的宫女都嫌他冷酷无情。

en.t: As a result, some of the palace women disliked him for being cold and heartless.
